title: 彭博：伊朗停火已死地缘风险推高通胀
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: When you see a response like this, how can we still call this a ceasefire?
segments.zh: 看到这样的回应，我们还能称之为停火吗？

segments.en: Oh, ceasefire is dead without question. This is war.
segments.zh: 停火无疑已经死亡，这是战争。

segments.en: The amount of targets that you're talking about here from SENTCOM is larger than I think anything we've launched in weeks.
segments.zh: 中央司令部提到的目标数量，比我们几周来发射的还要多。

segments.en: And there will be a real Iranian response.
segments.zh: 伊朗必将做出实质性回应。

segments.en: We can count on that. And I don't see how this doesn't further spin out of control into another real hot war.
segments.zh: 这很可能进一步失控，演变成另一场真正的热战。

segments.en: And that means higher gas prices, higher food prices, higher prices across the board.
segments.zh: 这意味着油价、食品价格以及所有物价都会上涨。

segments.en: For the American people. And that also means tanking Republican polling numbers, unfortunately, as you want to, because those two things have, as you explained last segment,
segments.zh: 对美国民众而言，这也会导致共和党民调数字下滑，因为这两者密切相关。

segments.en: have moved hand in hand. And so I think the risk for the country is that we are back in another shooting war.
segments.zh: 我认为国家的风险在于我们可能再次陷入一场热战。

segments.en: I think the risk for the president is that he doesn't convey that clear policy of what he's trying to achieve.
segments.zh: 总统的风险在于他没有传达出明确的政策目标。

segments.en: And Iran gets a vote on how this thing comes to an end.
segments.zh: 而伊朗对事态的结局拥有发言权。
